classification.rationale: The goods are described as parts of electric fuel pumps. Under Section XVI note 2(b), the valve plate, valve seat, valve body and protective cap are parts suitable solely or principally for fuel pumps of 8413.30.90, so they go to 8413.91.90, suffix .15. NY N011941 (in force) classified components of an automotive electric fuel pump in 8413.91.9010, the earlier suffix for parts of 8413.30.90 pumps. The capacitor is a good of heading 8532 under note 2(a) and must be classified separately.
